review:
An underwater Megaways game with Multi Chance: if matching symbols land on reels 2 to 6 but miss reel one, the first reel expands and respins to try to complete the win. Near misses sting a lot less.

Four scatters give eight free spins (plus two per extra scatter), and scatters in the bonus add modifiers: +1 spin, +1x to wins, removing the lowest symbol, or more wilds. Up to 10,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
